name: Becks Farm
tagline: A Family Farm in Minnesota's Heartland – Fresh Produce, Fall Festival, & Events
description: Becks Farm is an agritourism farm in 362 190 Th Ave, MN, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
